name: blender
description: Blender 3D creation suite with the blender-xray addon for STALKER X-Ray ogf/omf/skl/bones import and export; run headless for scripted model and animation pipelines

blender.description: Blender 3D suite; headless model/animation processing via --background --python, GUI otherwise. Carries the io_scene_xray addon for X-Ray asset import/export
blender.usage:
blender --version # Show version
blender -b --factory-startup --python script.py # Headless run a Python script
blender -b --python-expr "import addon_utils; addon_utils.enable('io_scene_xray')" # Enable the X-Ray addon
